customerOutcome: Review the native active workflow revision and its separate draft without mistaking declarations for effective authorization or passed tests.
entryConditions: Current authenticated principal and company selection; no retained foreign-principal payload
Effective feature admission is required for new work; native membership and resource authority remain necessary
exitConditions: Only a canonical server-confirmed result permits a success claim
Pending, stale, unavailable or unqualified work never becomes successful or activated

content.supportingCopy: Review the native active workflow revision and its separate draft without mistaking declarations for effective authorization or passed tests.
displayedState: Native published revision and draft are separate and explicitly versioned
Declared operation, possible effects, approval checkpoint, retry and test-mode metadata
Native connections and branch labels remain explicit; step numbering is not an execution trace
Oversized, duplicate, cyclic or dangling topology is unavailable, never silently truncated
Bound native-ID draft changes against the active revision; private values omitted; incomplete comparison is unavailable, never unchanged or approved.

primary.label: Review flow
primary.operation: Read the selected current native revision; no mutation or test result is created.

secondary: Authorized native Pause/Resume/Retire controls, each with separate consequence confirmation

canonicalReadDomains: Native workflows/revisions and current learned-asset privacy/lineage checks
Native workflows:read/edit grants and immutable node registry descriptors
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Review remains read-only; separate explicit lifecycle controls invoke the original native workflow owner (ADR-V9-023).
systemWork.authorityEffect: Presentation and drafts cannot grant permissions. Material effects always require current native permissions, approvals and version preconditions.
systemWork.asyncWork: One current native workflow detail read; projected response is limited to 100 nodes and 200 connections per revision. Account identity and native read admission are checked; existing native owner governs read latency.
systemWork.receipt: Native revision IDs and version numbers only. No representative test, approval decision, effective access or publish/run receipt is fabricated.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: An empty revision means no steps in that revision, not a tested process.
states.partial: Oversized, duplicate, cyclic or dangling-connection flows show flow unavailable with no truncated topology.
states.stale: Hide retained private data during background rechecks and live authority/privacy/version invalidations; a new query epoch rejects late prior responses.
states.validation_error: This read-only surface accepts no workflow inputs.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Re-resolve canonical state/version and the original request identity before permitting another effect.
states.success: Show only the native revision read. No execution, approval, publication or safety success is claimed.

navigation.back: Return to existing native workflow list.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No writes or browser-persisted draft data. Native Advanced editor retains canonical draft saves.
navigation.resume: Re-read current company/principal/native revision and grants. Flag rollback restores the existing graph editor; /advanced preserves a direct graph route.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Current human/company-authorized workflow name and description
sensitiveFields: Native graph configuration, prompts, credentials, inputs, schemas, variables, actor assignments and results are excluded from this projection
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Purpose-separated workflow-experience namespace for success and rejected requests; generic logs omit account query strings, workflow/customer prose and raw errors.

functional: Verify immutable active/draft separation, publication-free reads, native graph links, unknown operations, branch visibility and explicit bounds.

Complete per-step actor/input/effect/access policy, chat authoring, representative test/inspect/check/publish/safe run and full recovery remain open. Separate native lifecycle controls are specified in WORKFLOW-OPERATE/RETIRE.
Verify added/changed/removed native steps, dependency numbering, connection/data/settings indicators, private-value exclusion and unchanged immutable active source.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current native grants, membership revocation, account mismatch, foreign-company denial, agent denial, raw-config omission and late-response suppression.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
